**Verify** · Attach an independent report with real Windows launcher evidence, actual viewport sizes, browser actions, defects and reproducible results. Include Projects, Apps, SVAR, reader, Back, appearance and a second account.

**Delivery dependencies** · WI-075, WI-076

**Queue** · Follows WI-077 in the v0.3 delivery order.

**Target** · PI-03, v0.3.
